limitations: Source MJCF rigid-body model, not yet matched to USD/PhysX runtime.
Fixed-base local linearization excludes contact, floating-base motion and changing contact phase.
Source damping and armature included explicitly; Coulomb friction/contact constraints are not simulated.
Foot Jacobians refer to specified body-local test points, not measured mesh/PhysX contact patches.
SISO channels retain cross coupling and require superposition over every input.
Direct high-order polynomial evaluation near B=1 may be ill-conditioned; use exported state-space arrays for numerical control.
